The paladin's standard weapon, the Radiant Longsword — but only when used with the 'Blessed Strike' ability after absorbing the first drop of Blessed Water.

The Sanctified Blade — a weapon forged from the purified core of the Devotee's own shattered reliquary. Only the blade that was once the Devotee's holy artifact can harm it. The paladin must wield the Sanctified Blade (acquired from this encounter) to deal damage. Standard weapons are repelled by its holy aura.

The Sanctified Blade — this is the *only* weapon that can damage it. The boss is encased in a shield of corrupted faith that nullifies all other holy energy, including divine smite. The Sanctified Blade is its own soul's last remnant — it was forged from the original weapon of the saint before he fell. Striking the core (a pulsing black heart visible in its chest) with the blade while it is momentarily vulnerable (after a failed holy scream) deals triple damage.

Vulnerable to fire damage — their brittle, petrified flesh ignites easily. Their movement is slow, but they explode in a toxic cloud upon death, damaging the ranger and obscuring vision.

The Shade is immune to physical and fire damage, but is disrupted by sound. Any loud noise — including the Ember Torch's ignition sound or the ranger's own bowstring twang — causes it to phase out of reality for 2 seconds. The ranger must use the Ember Torch's ignition sound to stagger it repeatedly.

The Hollow Warden is immune to all damage except when struck by the Whispering Arrow — a spectral arrow forged from the soul-echo of the first fallen guardian. The arrow can only be fired after the ranger has acquired the Soulbow String. The Warden's core is only exposed for 3 seconds after it completes its 'Soul Siphon' animation, during which it drains the ranger's stamina and health. The Soulbow String must be used to fire the Whispering Arrow during this window.

Vulnerable to temporal rewind effects — if player uses the Resonance Core Fragment's pulse ability to rewind 5 seconds of their own movement, enemies become disoriented and take 15 bonus damage for 4s
Vulnerable to the Resonance Core Fragment's Slow Pulse — when activated near the enemy, their own time-manipulation backlash damages them (5 damage/sec for 4s)

The Veil Stalker is immune to physical strikes while cloaked, but its thermal signature becomes visible when hit by the *Phase-Shift Catalyst* — a temporary pickup dropped after defeating it.

The Resonance Warden is armored in adaptive harmonic shielding. It cannot be damaged by physical strikes unless the *Phase-Shift Catalyst* is activated within 2 meters of it — this causes its shields to overheat and vibrate at a destabilizing frequency, making it vulnerable to *resonant strikes*.

The Sentinel is immune to all damage except when the player is standing within the *Echo-Blade Resonant Pulse's* radius during its 3-second vulnerability window. Its armor absorbs kinetic energy — but not harmonic dissonance. If the player has not acquired the Echo-Blade upgrade, this enemy is unkillable.
